newsitem.title: USA: Loch Harris unit in Mexico solar pump deal.
newsitem.headline: Loch Harris unit in Mexico solar pump deal.

text.p: Loch Harris Inc said Thursday its AgraTech Inc unit has a contract worth at least $15 million over 12 months to supply solar powered water pumps to Mexico.

The company said it struck the deal with Phoenix, Ariz.-based Sanchez International. Other terms of the deal were not disclosed because of continuing negotiations on another acquisition, Loch Harris said.
U.S. Aerodyne's solar pumps will be assembled in Texas and shipped to Mexico, Loch Harris said. Loch Harris on Monday announced plans to buy U.S. Aerodyne.
